subject: Users unable to complete SSO login
resolution: Confirmed the identity provider configuration and restored the affected connection.
steps: Confirm whether the issue affects one user or the entire workspace.
Check the identity provider status and recent configuration changes.
Escalate a confirmed multi-user outage to the identity team.

subject: Seat count differs from current assignments
resolution: Explained the billing-cycle seat calculation and submitted a refund request for human review when eligible.
steps: Compare billed seats with the invoice period and seat-change history.
Explain the applicable billing policy with a knowledge citation.
Require approval before submitting a refund request.

subject: Scheduled API sync receives rate limits
resolution: Adjusted the sync schedule to use documented exponential backoff and checked the account's plan limits.
steps: Review request frequency and the response headers.
Use exponential backoff and respect the documented rate limit.
Escalate persistent 429 responses after the retry policy is applied.

subject: File upload blocked by workspace quota
resolution: Reviewed storage usage and explained the options available under the current plan.
steps: Confirm the workspace's current usage and quota.
Identify large or duplicated files without deleting customer data.
Explain plan options and request approval before any account change.

subject: Third-party integration stopped syncing
resolution: Reconnected the integration after the customer confirmed the authorization flow.
steps: Check CloudDesk service health and the integration status.
Review whether the third-party authorization expired.
Get customer confirmation before reconnecting an account.
